regions.region: title, abstract, and two-column Results and Discussion prose
regions.finding: The prose identifies the Pt-catalyzed allenol-to-carbazole transformation, narrates Table 1 optimization outcomes, summarizes Table 2 scope, and states that ESI exists; no SI file was supplied or associated.

The upper arrow is cited prior work and is classified as a literature example; the lower arrow is a generic current-paper transformation to carbazole 3, while bracketed 2 is described as the envisioned rather than observed product.
Text proposes intermediates 4–7, water loss, a cyclic vinylic platinum carbene, and a 1,2-H shift; these are classified as mechanism content, not separate experiments.

unresolved: The supplied main paper points to ESI for procedures and characterization, but no SI was explicitly provided; operational details remain missing.
The lower Scheme 1 arrow shows PtCl4/THF while the prose/Table 1 initial PtCl4 experiment uses toluene; both source statements are retained in their own record contexts.
Most Table 2 compounds are defined through an R-group template and were not assigned SMILES without independent structure review.

regions.region: upper-left Table 1 including reaction drawing and footnotes
regions.finding: Eleven distinct optimization experiments were extracted row by row. Visual review confirms entry 6 is 3 h and 80% (not the OCR-joined '38 0'); entry 3 retains the table dash plus 92% recovered 1a; entry 4 includes 10 mol% AgOTf; parenthesized values in entries 5 and 11 are isolated yields.
Fig. 1 is an ORTEP representation of 3g and not a reaction. Scheme 2 is a proposed catalytic mechanism and is represented by one mechanism record rather than by isolated experimental intermediates.

regions.region: lower half Table 2 including generic arrow and all rows
regions.finding: Nineteen substrate-scope rows were extracted independently with row-specific R1–R5 assignments, 5 mol% PtCl2, toluene, room temperature, reaction time, and isolated yield linked to the row product.

unresolved: Reaction scale, atmosphere, workup, and purification are absent from the supplied main-text page.
The table does not provide unique machine-readable structures for most R-group-defined rows; these remain unverified and without SMILES.

regions.finding: No new reaction row is introduced. The authors state that Table 2 entries 5, 6, and 13 were reproduced; this is linked as supplemental evidence to those existing records rather than counted as new experiments.

The page consists mainly of cited prior literature and is not converted into experiments of the current paper. Footnote 13 supplies crystal data for 3g/CCDC 713481 and is linked as characterization context to Table 2 entry 7, not as a reaction outcome.

unresolved: The reproduced experiments are not accompanied by separate batch conditions or measurements on this page.
Cited papers were not treated as source documents, so their experimental details remain outside this extraction.
